items.name: Please Be Finished Brisbane 2026

venue.name: The Brisbane Finnish Hall
venue.address: 62 Newnham Rd, Mount Gravatt East QLD 4122

items.information:
Please note, this competition **does not include the 3x3 cube event** - we recommend signing up to the Speedcubing Australia mailing list to be notified as new competitions are announced.

Competitors are encouraged to bring a guest who is familiar with the process of judging blindfolded solving.
![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Jagera and Turrbal people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

items.name: Braunschweig Open 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ3OTA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--58b37c01300fc6b2d8c109a0acdfcfa3068eef29/WhatsApp%20Image%202025-12-09%20at%2021.15.50.jpeg)

Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur ersten Competition in Braunschweig in der Geschichte der WCA. Wir, das Orga-Team freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. 

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**

We cordially invite you to the first competition in Braunschweig in the history of the WCA. We, the organising team, look forward to seeing many of you there.

**Please read all tabs carefully so that you are familiar with the schedule and all the details.**

items.name: PBQtah 9 2026
items.information:
# **This competition only has blindfolded events and FMC. We do not recommend this competition for first time competitors**

This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at UVU. Membership is open to both UVU and non-UVU students. For more details, visit the [Cubing Club at UVU tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQtah92026#61984-cubing-club-at-uvu).

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.name: Morrow Quiet Mania 2026
items.information:
This competition takes place on **SATURDAY** and only features Clock, FMC, and Blindfolded events. Therefore, it may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please click [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MorrowMixupMania2026) to view the page for the Morrow Mixup Mania 2026 competition which does feature 3x3, or see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. 

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/)

Morrow Quiet Mania 2026 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](www.midwestcubing.org)
